study: Fixed-candidate feedback and Gaussian scoring comparison
scoring: Gaussian marginal composite score using the exact unconditional residual marginal variances; compared with the exact Gaussian joint likelihood retaining temporal residual covariance.
truth_selection: Each fixed candidate is evaluated as the generating drift.
pairing: Identical standard-normal noise realization across feedback strengths and noise scales within each candidate-set/truth block.
state_metrics: Trajectory RMSE of uniform-candidate analysis mean and composite-score-weighted analysis mean. Weights include the current observation score before the analysis mean is formed.
blackout: All scoring variants and feedback strengths start from the same final observation y_T. The selected or weighted candidate drift is propagated for 20 steps. Also report drift-only horizon error.
intervals: Wilson 95% intervals for selection rates; 10000 paired bootstrap means for existing FHN/PK effects; normal 95% intervals across simulated trajectory summaries.
